# statuspal-next_automations (Data Source)

Lists the incident automations on a status page.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Lists the incident automations on a status page.
data "statuspal-next_automations" "acme" {
  status_page_subdomain = "acme-status"
}

output "automation_trigger_urls" {
  value     = [for a in data.statuspal-next_automations.acme.automations : a.trigger_url]
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `status_page_subdomain` (String) Subdomain of the status page whose automations to list.

### Read-Only

- `automations` (Attributes List) Automations on the status page. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--automations))
